svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.28.3.1 Materials
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO

g.text: Lath fastened through the sheathing to the studs, (1)
Drawn 4 times actual, at the minimum

svg.text: Fasteners for stucco lath or reinforcing are
corrosion-resistant and of a material other
Galvanized steel is given as an example of a corrosion-resistant material, the Article names none.
